plan: Sell all SOXL, MUU, and SPAL to eliminate leveraged ETF exposure and comply with the mandate.
Sell all METU, PLTU, and MSFU to further reduce leveraged exposure.
Trim QQQI to 20% to maintain a diversified income base while adhering to single-name limits.
This plan prioritizes capital preservation by removing high-risk leveraged positions.
It focuses on broad market and income-generating assets for stability.
conservative.read: This conservative approach aims for a modest ~1.5%/month return, prioritizing capital preservation. It significantly reduces drawdown risk by eliminating leveraged ETFs and high-beta single names. Expect lower volatility and more stable returns.

plan: Trim SOXL to 3%, MUU to 2%, and SPAL to 2% to reduce leveraged ETF exposure and meet mandate limits.
Trim METU to 3%, PLTU to 2%, and MSFU to 2% to reduce overall leveraged exposure.
Buy TSM at 4% to add high-quality semiconductor exposure from the scanner's top setups.
This plan balances risk and growth, maintaining some leveraged exposure within limits.
It aims for diversified growth with a focus on quality tech names.
balanced.read: This balanced approach targets ~2.5%/month growth, focusing on risk-first growth. It reduces overall leverage and concentration while adding a high-quality new name. Expect moderate volatility and growth potential.

plan: Add to SOXL, MUU, and SPAL to 6% each, leaning into leveraged ETFs within mandate limits.
Add to METU, PLTU, and MSFU to 6% each, increasing leveraged AI/Software exposure.
Buy TSM at 6% to add high-conviction semiconductor exposure from the scanner.
This plan aggressively presses into high-scoring setups and uses leverage for growth.
It aims to maximize upside potential, accepting higher risk and volatility.
aggressive.read: This aggressive approach targets ~4%/month growth by leaning into leveraged ETFs and high-conviction setups. Be aware this significantly increases both upside and drawdown potential. Leveraged ETFs decay daily, and this mode can incur substantial losses quickly if stops are not strictly adhered to.

plan: Sell all SOXL, MUU, and SPAL to eliminate leveraged ETFs and reduce risk.
Sell all METU, PLTU, and MSFU to remove high-beta single names.
Add to QQQI to 30% to increase exposure to income-generating ETFs.
This plan prioritizes steady monthly distributions and low drawdown.
It aims to park cash for yield, focusing on income over growth.
income.read: This income-focused approach targets ~1%/month, prioritizing steady distributions and low drawdown. It significantly reduces exposure to growth and leveraged assets. Remember, distributions are variable, and NAV can still fall in market downturns; this is not a savings account.
